text:
kai: Heads-up: capturing a perf regression on mixtral-24 MoE serving. p99 token latency up ~35% after yesterday's kernel changes. Root cause looks like router logits fragmentation + repeat kernel selection churn.

lucas: Can you share the flamegraph / topo? last night we merged the new batch allocator.

kai: pasted small trace, here's top lines:
```
router_forward -> 42ms
k-selection -> 18ms (+)
allgather -> 26ms (expert comms)
kv_lookup -> 5ms
```

priya: router logits fragmentation => more frequent top-k swaps, causes kernel rebinds. Did you try forcing stable top-k (deterministic topk) flag?

kai: yes, forced topk=static and latency dropped 20% at p99. But throughput lower slightly.

sara: interesting—RoPE scaling might be increasing softmax sharpness on router features. which rope scale are you using?

kai: using default rope_scale=1.0. Scaling to 0.9 smoothed logits and reduced churn. quick perf cmd:
```
kubectl exec -it profiler -- /bin/sh -c "curl -s localhost:9090/debug/trace | grep router_forward -A3"
```

perf-bot: deploy-bot: Canary deployed: mixtral-24-rope-0.9 + deterministic-topk -> nodes: r5-gpu-prod-3

lucas: kernel selection churn: our runtime picks different kernels when seq_len dynamics change. if topk demotion changes expert counts per batch, kernel heuristics flip. we should incorporate expert_count stability into kernel-key.

priya: propose heuristic: prefer kernel_packed if expert_count variance < 0.2 across batch, else kernel_flexible. Also cache kernel choice per model+topk combo for 10s.

sara: KV cache pressure noted: when experts remap, kv cache misses spike because key offsets change. need stable expert assignment or a lazy remap strategy.

kai: agrees. plan: 1) enable deterministic topk in router; 2) rope_scale=0.9 for canary; 3) add kernel choice sticky for 10s; 4) add lazy KV remap. will run canary for 6h and report.

sara: :thumbsup: ping me if p99 > target after 30m.

lucas: also capture per-expert queue depth and kernel-select histograms, add to tracing UI.

kai: will upload traces to /mnt/ci/perf/1845103456 after run.
